name: Calypsow
summary: Defensive tall fescue blend with strong disease depth and summer-stress focus.
buyHint: Heritage / specialty turf dealers. Ask for Calypsow by name.
notes: Published cultivar set. Unweighted when scoring unless bag percents are on your tag.

name: Resilience II
summary: Equal-part elite blend with strong transition-zone and appearance traits.
buyHint: Twin City Seed and dealers that stock TCS blends. 5–50 lb bags.
notes: 4th Millennium SRP may be missing from the 2018–2023 NTEP extract — absence is a data gap, not a quality judgment.

name: Optimum
summary: Four-way of A-LIST / Lateral Spread cultivars aimed at heat, traffic, and brown patch.
buyHint: Mountain View Seeds dealers and many SiteOne / pro shops. Confirm the current bag tag.
notes: From the Mountain View Optimum tech sheet. Bag percentages vary by lot.

name: Artimuss
summary: Equal-part MVS Lateral Spread cultivars sold as a named bag. Blue-tag certified, Gravity SL treated.
buyHint: lawnsynergy.com in 25 and 50 lb bags. Confirm the current tag — lots can shift a point or two.
notes: Published tag from Lawn Synergy. Remainder is inert matter, not filler seed.

name: Envy
summary: Three-way of NTEP-mapped tall fescues aimed at dark color, density, and brown patch.
buyHint: lawnsynergy.com in 10, 25, and 50 lb bags. Aimed at transition-zone lawns.
notes: Published Lawn Synergy cultivar list. Remainder is inert matter.

name: Resilience ‘After Dark’
summary: Three-way picked on NTEP genetic color ratings, with lateral spread from rhizomes and tillering.
buyHint: Twin City Seed direct in 5, 10, 25, and 50 lb bags.
notes: Published tag percentages. All three cultivars are in the 2018 trial, so the score covers the whole bag.

name: Blue Resilience
summary: The five Resilience II fescues at 18% each plus 10% bluegrass, added because bluegrass takes ice cover better.
buyHint: Twin City Seed direct in 5, 10, 25, and 50 lb bags.
notes: The one mixture here scored end to end: the fescues come from the 2018 fescue trial and Blue Gem from the 2017 bluegrass trial, weighted by label percentage. 4th Millennium SRP is the only part sitting outside a trial we hold.

name: GCI Turf Type Tall Fescue
summary: Blue-tag certified three-way of A-LIST cultivars, sold at 0% weed seed and 0% other crop.
buyHint: gciturfacademy.com in 10, 25, and 45 lb bags.
notes: GCI names the cultivars but not bag percentages, so the score weights the three equally.

name: Crown Jewel Elite
summary: Four-way tall fescue with the label printed on the page: 0% weed seed, 0% other crop, tested Poa free.
buyHint: Lawn Synergy, 50 lb bags only.
notes: Label percentages as published. Rendition RX and Honeymoon aren’t in the 2018 trial, so the score leans on Spyder 2LS and Daybreak.

name: Turf Saver RTF
summary: Barenbrug’s patented rhizomatous tall fescue, built to fill its own damaged spots instead of waiting on overseeding.
buyHint: Barenbrug distributors, plus the ‘Buy Now Online’ link on their product page.
notes: Barenbrug names Bonfire and Zion as the A-LIST varieties inside but doesn’t publish the full tag, so treat this score as covering the named portion.

name: Titan GLX
summary: Fifth-generation Titan sold as a straight variety, with gray leaf spot resistance added to the line.
buyHint: Twin City Seed in 5–50 lb bags. Blue tag rides along only on the unopened 50 lb bag.
notes: One cultivar, so the score is that cultivar’s trial data with nothing averaged in.

name: Xanadu
summary: Straight Xanadu — fine texture and dark color, bred toward brown patch resistance.
buyHint: Twin City Seed in 5–50 lb bags.
notes: One cultivar, so the score is that cultivar’s trial data with nothing averaged in.

name: Firecracker G-LS
summary: Straight Firecracker G-LS, a Lateral Spread cultivar carrying gray leaf spot resistance.
buyHint: United Seeds in 10, 25, and 50 lb bags.
notes: One cultivar, so the score is that cultivar’s trial data with nothing averaged in.

name: Bonfire
summary: Straight Bonfire from the Jacklin line, sold on establishment speed and disease tolerance.
buyHint: United Seeds in 10, 25, and 50 lb bags.
notes: Same cultivar Barenbrug names inside Turf Saver RTF, here as a straight bag.

name: Premium Double Dark Green
summary: Blue-tag certified three-way of Summer, Zion, and Bonfire, sold on color and striping.
buyHint: Yard Mastery in 6, 12, 25, and 45 lb bags. The same bag also shows up under Lawn Care Nut, Golf Course Lawn Store, and MySoil’s own store.
notes: Cultivars named but not weighted, so the score splits them evenly. Summer sat out the 2018 trial; Zion and Bonfire carry the score.

name: Cool Blue
summary: 85% tall fescue and 15% Kentucky bluegrass, blue-tag certified, with the bluegrass there to spread into thin spots.
buyHint: Yard Mastery in 25 and 45 lb bags. GCI sells the same seed, but only the Yard Mastery listing names the bluegrass.
notes: Every cultivar here sits in a trial we hold — the three fescues in the 2018 fescue test, Midnight in the 2017 bluegrass test. Only the 85/15 species split is published, not per-cultivar percentages, so the four score evenly.

name: Landzie Tall Fescue
summary: Three-way of GLX Aced, Saltillo, and Lifeguard, sold on all three carrying TWCA drought qualification.
buyHint: Landzie direct in 25 lb bags.
notes: No percentages published, so the score splits them evenly. Saltillo isn’t in the 2018 trial; GLX Aced and Lifeguard carry the score.

name: Merit Select Lawn Mix
summary: Three named fescues at 30% each plus 10% Kentucky bluegrass, from an Ohio seed house.
buyHint: Merit Seed in 6, 12, 25, and 50 lb bags.
notes: The label’s last 10% is listed as plain Kentucky bluegrass with no cultivar named, so it isn’t shown or scored. Wichita sat out the 2018 trial, leaving Lafayette and Providence to carry the score.

name: Kentucky 31
summary: The forage-type fescue still sold at box stores. Coarse, light green, and a useful NTEP check — not an elite lawn blend.
buyHint: Home Depot, Lowe’s, Ace, and farm co-ops. Compare elite blends against this, don’t start here if you want turf-type density.
notes: Included as the widely available baseline so ‘best for my zone’ has something cheap to beat.

name: Riviera Bermudagrass
summary: OSU-bred seeded bermuda sold as a named bag. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Hancock Seed, Seed Barn, and Johnston Seed when in stock.
notes: Single named cultivar. Crop shortages happen — confirm availability before you plan a full lawn.

name: Monaco Bermudagrass
summary: Johnston Seed / Barenbrug Monaco with Yellow Jacket coating. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Barenbrug distributors and Johnston Seed. Often sold coated.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial. Availability varies by season.

name: Copperhead Bermudagrass
summary: DLF Copperhead (DLF-460/3048) seeded bermuda. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: DLF wholesale / pro turf dealers. Ask for Copperhead by name.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial.

name: Sun Queen Bermudagrass
summary: Pure-Seed Testing seeded bermuda (PST-R6MM). In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Justin Seed and Atlas Turf dealers. Often sold coated as PureCoat+.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial.

name: TifTuf Bermudagrass
summary: University of Georgia hybrid known for holding up on less water. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Super-Sod by the roll or pallet in AL, GA, NC, SC, TN, and TX; elsewhere use The Turfgrass Group’s grower finder.
notes: Patented hybrid — it is licensed sod and sprigs only, so no seed exists to compare against. Trial data is real either way.

name: Tahoma 31 Bermudagrass
summary: Oklahoma State hybrid bred for cold tolerance, which pushes bermuda further north than most. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Licensed sod farms — Riverside Turf ships and does farm pickup in Virginia.
notes: Licensed vegetative variety: sod or large-batch sprigs only, no plugs and no seed.

name: Latitude 36 Bermudagrass
summary: Oklahoma State hybrid sold for southern and transition-zone lawns. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Plug trays ship direct from Sod Solutions; full lawns come from their licensed sod farms.
notes: Vegetative only — plugs for patching, sod for a whole lawn. There is no Latitude 36 seed.

name: Celebration Bermudagrass
summary: Blue-green hybrid with better shade tolerance than most bermudas. Ran in the 2019 NTEP trial as Celebration Hybrid.
buyHint: Plug trays direct from Sod Solutions, or a licensed farm for pallets.
notes: Vegetative only. Entered the trial under its breeding code MSB-1017, which is why the tables show ‘Celebration Hybrid’.

name: Tifway 419 Bermudagrass
summary: The fine-textured Tifton hybrid that has been the default sod bermuda for decades, and the trial’s standard entry.
buyHint: Most sod farms in the South carry it. Super-Sod sells it in AL, NC, SC, and TN.
notes: Hybrid, so it can’t be grown from seed. Useful as the baseline the newer hybrids are measured against.

name: Astro Bermudagrass
summary: Medium-bladed hybrid that is the everyday lawn bermuda across Oklahoma. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Oklahoma sod farms by the pallet — Heartland in El Reno, Green Acre around Tulsa.
notes: Sod only. The trial lists Astro as a vegetative entry sponsored by the Oklahoma Sod Producers Association.
